The file changed on disk mid-planning (unrelated edits — repo went public,
some git-workflow rewording). Before editing it, re-read it fresh to build on
the current version, not the one quoted during planning.

## Approach

### 1. Worktree (mandatory per this repo's own workflow rule)

```bash
git fetch origin main
git worktree add -b chore/translate-french-comments-to-english \
  .worktrees/chore/translate-french-comments-to-english origin/main
cd .worktrees/chore/translate-french-comments-to-english
```

All edits happen inside this worktree.

### 2. Translate Go comments — batched, parallel subagents, no file overlap

Comment-only edits: no logic changes, no renames, no reformatting beyond what
translation requires. Preserve technical meaning exactly — a comment that
explains a workaround or invariant must keep explaining the same workaround or
invariant, just in English. Run each batch as an independent agent (they touch
disjoint file sets, so no merge conflicts) — same worktree makes filesystem
edits, so batches can be dispatched in parallel:

| Batch | Scope | Approx. lines |
|---|---|---|
| A | `internal/ui/dashboard/*` (9 files) | ~692 |
| B | `internal/ui/keymap/*` (3 files — includes the package doc-block) | ~178 |
| C | `internal/config/config.go`, `internal/app/*`, `internal/status/*`, `internal/metrics/*`, `internal/command/*` | ~348 |
| D | `internal/ui/theme/*`, `internal/ui/components/*`, `internal/ui/status/*`, `internal/ui/forge/{auth,explorer}/*`, `internal/ui/security/*` | ~250 |
| E | `internal/ui/datatable/*`, `internal/ui/about/*`, `internal/ui/workspaces/*`, `internal/ui/oci_resources/*`, `internal/ui/{help,shortcut,registryalias,netdiag,containers,vocabtest,viewer}/*` | ~200 |
| F | `internal/scan/*`, `internal/cache/*`, `internal/docker/*`, `internal/version/*`, `internal/credentials/*`, `internal/mcp/*`, `internal/jobs/*`, `internal/forge/{github,gitlab}/*`, `internal/netcheck/*`, `internal/ports/*`, `internal/viewer/json.go`, `internal/shared/state.go`, `main.go` | ~200 |

Each batch's agent should be told explicitly: translate only `//` comment
text; do not touch string literals; do not touch code; if a comment is already
English, leave it; if a line mixes English and French sentences, translate
just the French sentence(s) in place.

### 3. Translate rule/doc prose — done as one pass, not split

`.claude/CLAUDE.md` and the 7 files under `.claude/rules/` (`code-editing.md`,
`code-quality.md`, `planning.md`, `tui.md`, `tui-behavior.md`, `tui-forms.md`,
`tui-layout.md`, `tui-tables.md`, `tui-theme.md`) are heavily cross-referenced
and share terminology (rule numbers, `§3.xx` backlog references, recurring
concepts like "footer", "datatable", "shortcut"). Translate these as a single
coordinated pass (one agent or done directly) rather than splitting by file, so
terminology stays consistent across files. Rules:
- Keep every code sample, table, Markdown structure, and `Rule NNN` / `§3.xx`
  cross-reference byte-identical.
- Keep the rule's reasoning intact — these documents justify each rule with a
  concrete "why" (an incident, a measurement, a rejected alternative); that
  argument must survive translation, not just the imperative.
- Do not touch `docs/backlog.md` even where a rule file links to it.
- Re-read `.claude/CLAUDE.md` immediately before editing (see moving-target
  note above).

### 4. Verification

Inside the worktree:
```bash
mise run fmt      # gofmt — comment translation must not break formatting
mise run vet
mise run lint     # golangci-lint — Rule 301/305 checklist
go build ./...
go test ./...
```
Then spot-read a sample of diffs across batches (at least `internal/ui/keymap/keymap.go`,
`internal/ui/dashboard/sections.go`, and one `.claude/rules/*.md` file) to confirm
meaning was preserved, not just words swapped.

### 5. Commit, push, PR — stop before merge

One commit, English message per Rule 304/307 format, e.g.:
```
chore: translate French comments and rule docs to English

this clears the pre-existing backlog in Go source comments and in the
.claude/rules/*.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md convention docs. docs/backlog.md
and CHANGELOG.md are left untouched (historical log / generated file).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

```

gh pr create -R anthnel/devdesk --base main --head chore/translate-french-comments-to-english --fill
